title: Đêm không ngủ
about: Round 24, song-tau ("1. Piano + viola: Piano chơi giai điệu thưa; viola kéo những nốt trung trầm, chỉ xuất hiện cuối câu"): F minor at 64 bpm, a sparse tune (two notes a bar, a held note every fourth bar), one soft deep note a chord, the violas only at each sentence's end; a middle section in A-flat major. An original tune.
